passages.title: Photography Talk
passages.text:
Boy: Did you see the photos I took at the park yesterday?
Girl: Yes, they're really good! The lighting on the lake was perfect. But why didn't you get closer to the birds? They look a bit small.
Boy: I know, but I didn't want to scare them away. Next time I'll use a better zoom lens.
Girl: Good idea. Still, you've got a real talent for finding great angles.

passages.title: Weekend Hiking Plans
passages.text:
Girl: Are you coming on the mountain hike this weekend?
Boy: I'd love to, but my boots are completely worn out. I need to buy a new pair before I do any serious climbing.
Girl: You could always borrow my brother's. He's got some spares.
Boy: Thanks, but hiking boots need to fit perfectly, otherwise you get terrible blisters. I'll just go shopping on Saturday instead.

passages.title: Playing a Board Game
passages.text:
Girl: That new board game we played last night was so complicated!
Boy: Really? I thought the rules were quite straightforward once we started.
Girl: Easy for you to say! You won! I spent half the time trying to figure out what my cards meant.
Boy: Well, it does take a couple of rounds to get used to it. Let's play again tonight and I'll help you.

passages.title: Guitar Practice
passages.text:
Boy: How are your guitar lessons going?
Girl: Okay, I suppose. My teacher wants me to practice classical music, but I really want to learn rock songs.
Boy: Classical is great for your technique, though. It makes your fingers much stronger.
Girl: I know, and I can feel the difference already. It's just not as fun as playing my favorite bands' tracks.

passages.title: Italian Cooking Class
passages.text:
Girl: How was the Italian cooking class yesterday?
Boy: Great! We made fresh pasta from scratch. It was much easier than I thought it would be.
Girl: Really? I always thought you needed special machines for that.
Boy: We just used a rolling pin and a knife. The chef was brilliant at explaining each step. I can't wait to try making it at home for my family.

passages.title: Watching a Sci-Fi Film
passages.text:
Boy: Did you watch that new sci-fi film last night?
Girl: Yes, I did. The special effects were absolutely amazing, especially the space battles.
Boy: Definitely. But I felt the story was a bit weak. It was just like every other space movie.
Girl: I agree. You could guess the ending after the first twenty minutes. But it was still highly entertaining.
